Dispersez la patrouille du Loup qui tien: Scatter the Wolf patrol holding the first trail.
Chassez les éclaireurs du Loup avant qu’: Drive off the Wolf scouts before they warn the lair.
Repoussez le raid du Loup avant qu’il n’: Repel the Wolf’s raid before it reaches the hamlet.
Repoussez les créatures qui harcèlent la: Repel the creatures harrying the terrace road.
Abattez le wyrm rendu fou par une énergi: Bring down the wyrm driven mad by a dark energy.
Prenez le repaire du Loup et reprenez le: Take the Wolf’s lair and recover the Echo Crystal for Kaelen.
Prenez le repaire du Loup et gardez le C: Take the Wolf’s lair and keep the Echo Crystal for the clan.
Frayez-vous un passage parmi les bêtes s: Cut your way through the beasts in the Shadows’ grip.
Traquez le Chaman des Ombres avant qu’il: Hunt down the Shadow Shaman before he leaves the Peaks.
Affrontez Kaelen et ses gardiens pour le: Face Kaelen and his guardians for the Seal of the Dragon.
Les Pics Célestes. Deux Sceaux dans notr: The Celestial Peaks. Two Seals in our coffer, and the highest mountain we have ever climbed.
Le Clan du Dragon garde ici des savoirs: The Dragon Clan keeps knowledge here older than all the clans of the plains. It listens little, and weighs what it hears for a long time.
Un clan si sage qu’il n’a besoin de pers: A clan so wise it needs no one. Let’s see what it asks of us all the same.
Un guerrier du Loup, seul, sous un drape: A Wolf warrior, alone, under a flag of truce. He’s left his weapon planted in the snow, well away from him.
Le Dragon vous envoie reprendre son Cris: The Dragon sends you to take back its Crystal. The Wolf offers you better: do not take it back. Leave it where it is, and the Wolf will share the valleys the Dragon keeps for itself alone.
Prenez cet or en gage. Montez jusqu’au r: Take this gold as a pledge. Climb to the lair, and when the day comes, remember who spoke to you first.
Le Dragon et le Loup se disputent ces pi: The Dragon and the Wolf have fought over these peaks forever. Let them weaken each other, and the strongest at the end may well be the one who did not choose too soon.
Un clan qui vole un artefact puis achète: A clan that steals an artefact, then buys the silence of those who seek it… I would like to know why the Wolf needed this Crystal before I believe in its offer to share.
Repousser l’émissaire et prévenir Kaelen: Turn the envoy away and warn Kaelen.
Kaelen saura ce que le Loup a tenté: Kaelen will know what the Wolf attempted
Accept the gold and the Wolf’s pact.
Le Dragon vous remerciera du bout des lè: The Dragon will thank you grudgingly. The Wolf, for its part, will remember your answer.
I’ll send word to the hermitage. Kaelen will know a Wolf envoy has come down this far.
Alors nous nous reverrons au repaire. Le: Then we shall meet again at the lair. The Wolf keeps its word to those who keep theirs.
Des collets d’acier sous la neige, en tr: Steel snares under the snow, across the pilgrims’ path. The Wolf set them for those who climb to pray to the Dragon.
Let’s move them onto the Wolf’s paths. Its patrols will fall into them, and the lair will be less well guarded.
Les pèlerins passent aussi par là. Un co: The pilgrims pass that way too. A snare cannot tell a wolf from a child.
Désarmer les pièges du sentier des pèler: Disarm the traps on the pilgrims’ path.
Les retourner contre les patrouilles du: Turn them against the Wolf’s patrols.
Le sentier est sûr. Les pèlerins pourron: The path’s safe. The pilgrims can climb without watching where they put their feet.
Les collets attendent le Loup, maintenan: The snares wait for the Wolf now. I hope no one else comes this way.
Un ermitage du Dragon, accroché à la par: A Dragon hermitage, clinging to the rock face. The monks leave us the fire without asking questions.
Sans poser de questions, et sans rien no: Without asking questions, and without telling us anything either. The Dragon even keeps its silences.
They pray for the Crystal’s return. Let us rest; the Wolf’s lair is higher than anything we have crossed.
Un guerrier du Loup, blessé, abandonné p: A Wolf warrior, wounded, abandoned by his own at the edge of the terraces. He’s still conscious.
Achevez-moi ou laissez-moi. Je ne dirai: Finish me or leave me. I’ll say nothing of the lair.
Il dira tout, avec un peu d’encouragemen: He’ll say everything, with a little encouragement. The lair is guarded, and we know nothing of its defences.
Écoutons-le d’abord. Un clan qui vole un: Let us hear him first. A clan that steals a sacred artefact does not always act of its own accord; this warrior may know why.
Que faisons-nous de lui ?: What do we do with him?
Soigner ses blessures, l’écouter, puis l: Tend his wounds, hear him out, then release him.
Un acte que les Pics retiendront: A deed the Peaks will remember
Notre chef n’était pas ainsi, avant. Un: Our chief wasn’t like this before. A shaman came from who knows where, and since then he listens to no one but him. It was the shaman who wanted the Crystal.
Un chaman venu de nulle part, derrière u: A shaman from nowhere, behind a clan that no longer acts of its own accord. We have seen this before.
Il a parlé des gardes et des passages. I: He spoke of the guards and the passages. He will never speak of anything else again.
Une paroi gravée par les anciens du Drag: A rock face carved by the ancients of the Dragon. It speaks of the Echo Crystal: it holds the balance of the Peaks, but a hand that knew how to turn it could make it a weapon.
Une arme qui tient des montagnes en équi: A weapon that holds mountains in balance. That knowledge is worth more than all the Wolf’s gold. Why give it back to a clan that keeps it to itself?
Parce que ce n’est pas à nous de décider: Because it is not for us to decide who holds the mountains.
Que faisons-nous de ces inscriptions ?: What do we do with these inscriptions?
Kaelen saura ce que dit la paroi: Kaelen will know what the rock face says
Keep the Crystal’s secret for ourselves.
Un secret gardé pour le clan: A secret kept for the clan
Je les recopie trait pour trait. Kaelen: I am copying them stroke for stroke. Kaelen will know how to read them better than we do.
Je garde la copie, et la poussière de cr: I’ll keep the copy, and the crystal dust at the foot of the rock face. One day, that knowledge will serve us.
Le Dragon envoie des étrangers chercher: The Dragon sends strangers to fetch what it could not keep. Come and take it.
Le Cristal d’Écho. Il est chaud, et il t: The Echo Crystal. It is warm, and it trembles like a spring beneath the ice. Let us take it back to Kaelen.
Le chef est tombé, mais quelqu’un s’est: The chief’s fallen, but someone fled through the back of the lair. Not a Wolf warrior.
Vous aussi, vous voulez le Cristal pour: You want the Crystal for yourselves too. At least the Wolf does not pretend to serve the balance.
Le Cristal est à nous. Le Dragon devra t: The Crystal is ours. The Dragon will have to deal with those who hold the balance of its peaks.
Ou il viendra le reprendre, et nous n’au: Or it will come to take it back, and we will have no right to complain.
Le Cristal… n’était qu’un écho. Ceux que: The Crystal… was only an echo. Those I serve listen to other echoes, wherever your Seals lead you.
The Shadows, behind a third clan. The Wolf was only one more hand, like the Raven before it.
The Seal is yours. The Peaks have seen it. No longer count on the Dragon’s wisdom on the day you need it.
Le Loup a goûté vos lames et il a tourné: The Wolf tasted your blades and turned back. It’s the first night we’ve slept in weeks.
Des portes barricadées, des enfants cach: Barricaded doors, children hidden in the barns. This hamlet is waiting for an attack.
Le Loup descend chaque nuit depuis la di: The Wolf’s come down every night since the Crystal vanished. It takes the livestock, the stores, and it always comes back. The Dragon stays up there.
Ces gens paieraient cher pour dormir tra: These people would pay dearly to sleep in peace. Protection has a price, and no one else is offering it to them.
Ils paient déjà le Loup en bêtes et en p: They already pay the Wolf in livestock and in fear. Taking more from them would make us a second Wolf.
Que faisons-nous pour ce hameau ?: What do we do for this hamlet?
Monter la garde et repousser le prochain: Stand guard and repel the next raid.
Des torches sur le sentier, et des loups: Torches on the path, and wolves ahead of the men. The Wolf’s coming down, like every night. This time, we’re waiting for it.
Le Loup a vu nos feux et il a tourné bri: The Wolf saw our fires and turned back without a fight. For tonight, at least.
Ils ont vidé leur dernier coffre pour no: They emptied their last coffer for us. They look at us the way they look at the Wolf.
Borin vous a confié le Sceau de l’Ours,: Borin entrusted you with the Seal of the Bear, they say, and the Raven Spymaster will not see his mountains again. The Bear does not give its word lightly. Nor does the Dragon.
On parle aussi du Sceau de l’Ours arrach: There is also talk of the Seal of the Bear wrested from Borin by trial. The Peaks have keen eyes, strangers. They will watch what you do here.
Deux Sceaux vous ont menés jusqu’ici. Ce: Two Seals have brought you this far. What they are worth, I shall judge on the Peaks.
Le Clan du Loup a volé le Cristal d’Écho: The Wolf Clan has stolen the Echo Crystal. It has held the balance of these peaks since before your chronicles. Without it, the mountain cracks, the snow slides, and the valleys tremble.
Le Dragon ne demande pas d’aide ; il en: The Dragon does not ask for help; it accepts it, when it is worthy. Bring back the Crystal, and the Seal of the Dragon will hear your name.
Un artefact qui tient des montagnes ne s: An artefact that holds mountains is not handled without danger, Elder Kaelen. And a clan that steals it may know what it is doing, or someone knows on its behalf. Let us understand the Wolf before we strike it.
Ou laissons le Loup et le Dragon s’user: Or let the Wolf and the Dragon wear each other down. The Crystal will go to whoever holds it at the end… I only say what everyone thinks looking at these peaks.
Nous ne sommes pas venus vendre l’équili: We did not come to sell another clan’s balance.
Un Sceau ne se vend pas non plus. Ce qu’: Nor is a Seal for sale. What it opens, it can also close again, and the Dragon is careful whom it entrusts it to.
Alors, étrangers. Rapporterez-vous le Cr: So, strangers. Will you bring back the Echo Crystal?
Bring back the Crystal and demand nothing.
Parole claire devant le Dragon: A clear word before the Dragon
Demand a price for our help.
Le prix pèsera dans le jugement: The price will weigh in the judgement
Montez, alors. Le repaire du Loup est ha: Climb, then. The Wolf’s lair is high, and the Wolf sees far.
Vous chiffrez l’équilibre des Pics comme: You price the balance of the Peaks like merchandise. Take your gold. The Dragon will remember what it cost you.
Le repaire du Loup, creusé dans la paroi: The Wolf’s lair, dug into the rock face. The Crystal shines at the back, set on an altar that isn’t the Dragon’s. The Wolf’s chief guards it himself.
Les étrangers de la trêve. Le pacte scel: The strangers of the truce. Does the pact sealed with our envoy still hold? Then leave the Crystal where it is, and share the valleys with us.
Encore des étrangers au service du Drago: More strangers in the Dragon’s service. It has kept these peaks too long. The Crystal will go to whoever knows how to use it.
Ce Cristal appartient à l’équilibre des: This Crystal belongs to the balance of the Peaks, and this altar is nothing like a Wolf altar. Let us take it back, and return it to Kaelen.
Ou reprenons-le pour nous. Celui qui tie: Or take it back for ourselves. Whoever holds the Crystal holds the Dragon.
Prendre le repaire et rapporter le Crist: Take the lair and bring the Crystal back to Kaelen.
Combat contre le chef du Clan du Loup: Battle with the Chief of the Wolf Clan
Le Cristal rapporté au Dragon: The Crystal returned to the Dragon
Prendre le repaire et garder le Cristal: Take the lair and keep the Crystal for the clan.
Le Cristal gardé pour le clan: The Crystal kept for the clan
Tenir parole au Loup et lui laisser le C: Keep our word to the Wolf and leave it the Crystal.
Le Loup vous doit une faveur: The Wolf owes you a favour
Des étrangers qui tiennent parole. Le Lo: Strangers who keep their word. The Wolf will not forget that you chose the right side.
Et les Pics n’oublieront pas ce que nous: And the Peaks will not forget what we left in its hands.
Le guerrier du Loup que vous avez relâch: The Wolf warrior you released spoke of this shaman. He told the truth: these symbols are not the Wolf’s.
Ces symboles ne sont pas ceux du Loup. Q: These symbols are not the Wolf’s. Someone else lived among them.
Le camp du Loup, plus haut que le repair: The Wolf’s camp, higher than the lair, abandoned in haste. A tent set apart from the others, full of cold ashes and symbols traced on the ground.
Celui qui vivait ici est parti avant nou: Whoever lived here left before we came. He knew the lair would fall.
On dit que vous avez gardé le hameau des: They say you guarded the foothill hamlet. Nearly all of us come from there.
Comme les mineurs de l’Ours, ils veulent: Like the Bear’s miners, they want to speak in their own words. Let them walk with us.
Les mineurs de l’Ours se sont tus sous n: The Bear’s miners fell silent under our blades. I do not want the Peaks to count any more of them.
Ils ont vu ce que nous avons fait du Cri: They saw what we did with the Crystal. If they speak to Kaelen, we’ll have nothing left to explain.
Ils parlent beaucoup, et ce qu’ils diron: They talk a great deal, and what they say will no longer be ours once they are before Kaelen.
Le Loup nous retenait au repaire pour po: The Wolf held us at the lair to carry its provisions. We saw everything: the Crystal, the altar, the stranger who spoke to the chief.{0}
Nous voulons le dire nous-mêmes à l’Anci: We want to tell Elder Kaelen ourselves.
Merci. Nous monterons avec vous, mais de: Thank you. We will climb with you, but before Elder Kaelen, our words will be our own.
Ils se taisent. Les Pics, eux, ne se tai: They are silent. The Peaks will not be.
Les inscriptions que nous rapportons à K: The inscriptions we are bringing back to Kaelen spoke of a hand able to turn the Crystal. This taint is the trace of that hand.
Ce que disait la paroi restera entre nou: What the rock face said will stay between us, as agreed. But this taint says the same thing: someone tried to turn the Crystal.
Quelqu’un a voulu tourner le Cristal, et: Someone tried to turn the Crystal, and this taint is the trace of it.
Je l’ai déjà vue. Ce sont les preuves de: I have seen it before. It is the evidence of the Shadows that we entrusted to the Lion, on the plains: the same mark, the same coldness.
I have seen it before. It is the evidence of the Shadows that we still keep to ourselves, since the Lion’s plains: the same mark.
Je ne l’avais jamais vue d’aussi près, m: I had never seen it so close, but I know what it heralds.
Et c’est la même souillure que l’éclat d: And it is the same taint as the shard of the dark vein, in our coffer since the Bear’s mountains.
Les Ombres ne laissent jamais qu’une tra: The Shadows never leave more than one trace in any place. We’ll have to follow them elsewhere.
The Crystal’s altar, at the top of the Peaks. The stone is cracked, and a black taint oozes from the crack, like frozen ink.
Que faisons-nous de cette souillure ?: What do we do with this taint?
Je l’enferme dans un coffre doublé de pl: I am shutting it in a lead-lined chest, like the others. Kaelen will have to see it.
La souillure fond sous la flamme. L’aute: The taint melts under the flame. The altar’s clean, and we’ll never know what it was.
Les gens du hameau ont fait monter du pa: The hamlet’s people sent bread and wood all the way up here. They asked nothing in return.
Personne ne monte jusqu’ici. Le froid, c: No one climbs this far. Tonight, the cold belongs to us alone.
Kaelen nous attend demain. Tout ce que n: Kaelen expects us tomorrow. Everything we have done on these peaks will be laid before him.
Le Dragon pèse lentement. Il ne nous jug: The Dragon weighs slowly. It will not judge us on our words, but on what the Peaks remember of us.
Trois Sceaux, bientôt. Il viendra un jou: Three Seals, soon. A day will come when someone wants to know what they are truly for. I would like to have the answer before they do.
Le Cristal a été altéré par une énergie: The Crystal has been altered by a dark energy. The Wolf did not steal it for itself: a Shadow Shaman held it under his sway.
Ce chaman s’est enfui vers les cimes. Tr: This shaman has fled towards the summits. Hunt him down and purge this threat, and the Seal of the Dragon will seal our alliance.
Sa tente, au camp déserté du Loup, était: His tent, at the Wolf’s deserted camp, was full of his symbols. I’ll know his trail.
Celui qui tourne le Cristal ne reste jam: Whoever turns the Crystal never stays near the altar. We will have to go and find him.
Vous avez rendu au Dragon son jouet. Vou: You have given the Dragon back its toy. You have not yet understood who listens when the Crystal resounds.
Vous réclamez mon Sceau, et les Pics ne: You claim my Seal, and the Peaks do not entrust it to you. Then prove your strength to those who keep the balance: my guardians and I, against your company.
Vous voulez mon Sceau sans le mériter. A: You want my Seal without earning it. Then prove your strength to those who keep the balance: my guardians and I, against your company.
Ce n’est pas le premier jeune dragon que: It isn’t the first young dragon we’ve come across. In the Lion’s lands, we sealed a nest without touching it.
Dans les terres du Lion, nous avons chas: In the Lion’s lands, we hunted a young dragon for its gems. This one could not even defend itself.
Un nid dans la roche. Un jeune dragon, b: A nest in the rock. A young dragon, wounded, its flank blackened by a taint that isn’t a burn.
La même énergie sombre que sur les créat: The same dark energy as on the ridge creatures. It can heal, if we help it.
Ses écailles valent une armure entière c: Its scales are worth a whole suit of armour at a good smith’s. It won’t feel them go.
La souillure recule sous mes mains. Il n: The taint recedes under my hands. It watches us leave without fear.
Il ne se défend même pas. Je ne sais pas: It does not even defend itself. I do not know what is worst.

Le Cristal d’Écho chante de nouveau sur: The Echo Crystal sings again on its altar, because you brought the Echo Crystal back to the Peaks instead of seeking its price.
Vous avez repris le Cristal au Loup, c’e: You took the Crystal back from the Wolf, it is true. Then you kept the Echo Crystal for your clan, as if the balance of the Peaks were for sale.
Vous deviez rapporter le Cristal, et vou: You were to bring back the Crystal, and you left the Crystal in the Wolf’s hands. The Peaks already tremble at your bargain.
Le Cristal d’Écho n’a été ni rapporté ni: The Echo Crystal was neither brought back nor defended. I will seal nothing on a void.
Les pèlerins sont venus d’eux-mêmes raco: The pilgrims came of their own accord to tell what they saw at the lair. No one dictated their words to them, and that is why I listen to them.
Des pèlerins se taisent derrière vos lam: Pilgrims keep silent behind your blades. I know that silence, and I will not call it an absence of witnesses.
Aucun pèlerin n’est venu parler pour vou: No pilgrim came to speak for you. I have only what the Peaks remember.
Voici l’éclat de la souillure que nous a: Here is the shard of the taint we sealed near the altar. The Crystal was not only stolen, Elder: a dark energy touched it.
Les Pics connaissent votre nom, et ils l: The Peaks know your name, and they speak it with respect. Your word carries weight before me.
Votre nom a monté les sentiers avant vou: Your name climbed the paths before you. It is not enough, but I do not turn it away.
Votre nom est monté jusqu’ici, et il sen: Your name has climbed this far, and it smells of ash. Do not count on it to speak for you.
Vous revenez des cimes. Les Pics ont déj: You return from the summits. The Peaks have already spoken before you: their pilgrims, their beasts, their cracked altar. I have listened to them. I will listen to you next.
What the Peaks have seen will not change now. Tell me only what you ask of the Dragon.
Ask for the trial of the Dragon.
Il y a aussi ceci, Ancien, et les Pics e: There is this as well, Elder, and the Peaks bear the trace of it:
Et le Dragon n’oubliera pas ce qui pèse: And the Dragon will not forget what weighs against them:
The Seal of the Dragon is in your hands. Kaelen has sealed the Dragon’s alliance, and the Shadow Shaman has fallen on the summits he thought his own.
Le Sceau du Dragon est entre vos mains,: The Seal of the Dragon is in your hands, but you took the Seal of the Dragon by trial. Kaelen’s guardians let you pass; the Dragon will not forget this wrested Seal.
L’éclat de la souillure du Cristal voyag: The shard of the Crystal’s taint travels with us, sealed with the others. Every Seal adds a piece to a picture I do not like to look at.
La souillure est restée là-haut, ou n’es: The taint stayed up there, or is no more. What the Shadows wanted from the Crystal, we will only learn later.
Trois Sceaux. Le Tournoi des Grands n’es: Three Seals. The Tournament of the Great is not far now, and every clan we have met will remember the way we advanced.
